headlines.title: Heart damage may occur from getting too much light at night while we sleep, study finds
headlines.description: Too much light exposure during sleep may lead to potentially harmful changes in the structure and function of the heart, a new study suggests.

headlines.title: Billy Joel gives health update after brain surgery
headlines.description: Billy Joel revealed that he underwent brain surgery because he didn’t want to lose his “marbles.” The “Piano Man” singer admitted he initially balked at going under the knife for hydrocephalus, a disorder he was diagnosed with in 2025. NBC News medical contributor Dr. Kavita Patel explains what the surgery entails.

headlines.title: Inside New Campaign to Cut Maternal Death Rate in Half
headlines.description: According to the CDC, 87% of pregnancy-related deaths are preventable, so Olivia Walton, founder of Healthy Moms Healthy Babies America, and the organization's president Dr. Neel Shah, join TODAY to share that Walton and her husband are pledging $100 million to achieve their goal of cutting the U.S. maternal death rate in half. "Investing in maternal health care is the single most strategic thing we can do for the future of American prosperity," Walton says.

headlines.title: College kids attend ‘Wellness Darties’ as Gen-Z looks for more sober events
headlines.description: More health conscious college kids are celebrating some weekends at "wellness darties." Instead of binge day-drinking, these events have things like pilates, cold plunges or saunas. It's a move for a generation that is less alcohol obsessed. NBC News' Valerie Castro reports.

headlines.title: Naomi Watts Talks National Hot Flash Day, ‘Spider-Man' and More
headlines.description: Naomi Watts sits down with TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to talk about creating National Hot Flash Day and her menopause wellness brand, Stripes Beauty. “With more visibility and normalization we can solve problems.” She opens up about the "inherited shame” of menopause, receiving a career achievement award at the San Sebastián International Film Festival, and her roles in “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” and “All’s Fair.”

headlines.title: How often do you really need to wash your jeans? Here’s what experts say
headlines.description: According to experts, you should wash your jeans every few wears — or more often if you get them really dirty. Plus, here are the best detergents for washing jeans.

headlines.title: Shop Brooklinen’s Last Call sale: Save up to 75% on sateen sheets, blankets and more
headlines.description: Brooklinen’s Last Call sale has deals of up 75% off on sateen bed sheets, pillowcases, blankets and more.

headlines.title: What scalp massagers can — and can’t — do for hair
headlines.description: Scalp health is integral to hair health. We asked the experts for the best brushes and massagers to support a healthy scalp.

headlines.title: The best coffee makers for every kind of coffee drinker
headlines.description: Here are the best coffee makers to buy, from brands like Nespresso, Keurig, Breville and more. Options include drip coffee, pour-over and French press.

headlines.title: CDC warns of a summer spike in rabies exposures
headlines.description: A spike in exposures to rabies across the U.S. this summer has prompted the CDC to issue a health alert.

headlines.title: Baby girl is one of two deaths in Pennsylvania measles outbreak, coroner said
headlines.description: A 6-week-old baby girl is one of two people with measles who died in Pennsylvania, the Lancaster County coroner said Friday, as the nation’s measles tally hit a new 35-year record of 3,134 cases.

headlines.title: Texas AG Paxton investigates military healthcare contractor over denied claims
headlines.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has opened an investigation into a major military healthcare contractor over wrongfully denied medical claims.
